description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LeaveRequestParamHelperTrait' that provides helper methods for extracting and validating leave request parameters from API request objects within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving various leave parameters, setting durations, and generating validation rules, primarily used in leave management API endpoints.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIdParam
methods.description: Retrieves the leave type ID parameter from the request body as an integer.

methods.name: getFromDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'from' date parameter from the request body as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getToDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'to' date parameter from the request body as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getCommentParam
methods.description: Retrieves the comment parameter from the request body as a string or null.

methods.name: getDurationParam
methods.description: Retrieves a duration-related array parameter from the request body based on the provided key.

methods.name: getPartialOptionParam
methods.description: Retrieves the partial option parameter for partial day leaves as a string or null.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestParams
methods.description: Constructs and returns an instance of LeaveParameterObject with leave request parameters extracted from the request, handling multi-day and single-day leaves.

methods.name: setMultiDayPartialOptions
methods.description: Sets partial options for a multi-day leave request, including start and end durations based on request parameters.

methods.name: setSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for a single-day leave request.

methods.name: getGeneratedDuration
methods.description: Generates a LeaveDuration object based on request parameters and context (single or multi-day).

methods.name: getCommonParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Builds and returns a collection of validation rules for common leave request parameters, including validation for duration and partial options.

methods.name: getEndpointLogicException
methods.description: Returns a LogicException used when the trait is used outside of an Endpoint context.
